description: Scope, not just routing. The changeset spans two layers under src/main, so refactor-advisor fires on both — that much already worked. What did not: Step 5 dispatched it with a bare path, so the file list Step 4 had already computed was thrown away, and the reviewer was free to read the layers it prefers and report a pass on a file it never opened. The SCOPE block is that list; this asserts the presentation file is on it. Routing is path-only, so the files are created empty.
